definitions.gloss: large grain; large drop; large-sized (fruit, bead, etc.)
definitions.explanation: Describes something that comes in individual units (grains, drops, berries, etc.) that are notably large in size. Often used as a modifier with の.

examples.japanese: {大粒|おおつぶ}の{涙|なみだ}がこぼれた。
{大粒|おおつぶ}の{雨|あめ}が{降|ふ}り{始|はじ}めた。
examples.english: Large drops of rain started falling.

examples.japanese: この{品種|ひんしゅ}は{大粒|おおつぶ}の{苺|いちご}が{収穫|しゅうかく}できる。

notes:
{大粒|おおつぶ} describes something that comes in individual units (drops, grains, berries) that are notably large. It is almost always used as a modifier with の.

FORMS:
{大|おお} (large) + {粒|つぶ} (grain, drop, particle)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {大粒|おおつぶ}の{涙|なみだ}: large teardrops
- {大粒|おおつぶ}の{雨|あめ}: large raindrops
- {大粒|おおつぶ}の{葡萄|ぶどう}: large grapes
- {大粒|おおつぶ}の{苺|いちご}: large strawberries
- {大粒|おおつぶ}の{真珠|しんじゅ}: large pearls

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {小粒|こつぶ}: small grain/drop (antonym)
- {粒|つぶ}ぞろい: uniformly excellent (figurative use of {粒|つぶ})
